original_target.title: Equal-weight decomposition of quantum channels with bounded Kraus rank

verification: Literature and theorem-scope review; no independent whole-proof or Lean verification.
scope_comparison: Target is every m,n>=2, exactly n equal-weight CPTP components, each Kraus rank<=m. Kumar–Wolf current Conjecture1 retains this strong exact equal-weight claim. Their theorems cover qubit input/output and classical-quantum classes, unequal-weight qutrit decompositions or more than n terms. Counterexamples for actual extreme points do not refute allowed generalized extreme rank-bounded channels. Bounded current searches found no full match; not a certification of openness.
